corrected_sentence: At alpha=0.01, reconstruction cosine similarity decreased by 13.0% relative (0.534 to 0.464) and feature-sign recovery decreased by 12.4 percentage points (80.3% to 67.9%; 15.4% relative), while AUROC decreased by 0.1 percentage points.
mia_statement: MIA AUROC was 0.496 (eICU; 95% CI [0.496, 0.498]) and 0.507 (Cimas; 95% CI [0.506, 0.507]). Point estimates are near 0.5; confidence intervals are narrow given N=5 seeds. No substantial membership-inference advantage was detected under the evaluated attack.
